risks: Low: record review and interviews. The main risks are privacy harm from linking records and discomfort for nurses discussing errors; findings are reported by team without naming nurses.
consent: Waiver of consent requested for the record-based strand (secondary use, about 1,870 episodes, impracticable to consent); written informed consent for every interview, with the option to stop at any time.
data: Linked data held on the hospital research server with hospital numbers replaced by study codes; interview recordings deleted after transcription and checking; agency notes, if shared, received under a data-sharing agreement.
equity: PROGRESS-Plus: patients living alone, with limited English or with lower health literacy may be least able to notice or report line problems. The interview sample includes them deliberately, interpreters are booked, and results are reported by living arrangement and interpreter need.
effectiveness: The study succeeds if it shows where the service should act first; a finding that care arrangements matter more than line type is as useful as the reverse.
efficiency: Uses existing records and about 60 fellow hours; transcription is the main cost.
costs: About 2,400 for transcription and 600 for interpreter time within the service budget of 6,000.
grants: None for this phase; the results could support an application for a trial of a shared escalation pathway.
partnerships: Vascular access team, the home infusion agency (if it agrees), two patient partners who have had home antibiotics, and the hospital's patient experience office.
rebPath: Full REB review of the linked record study with a waiver request and of the interview strand, submitted for the board meeting of 2026-10-14 under ICH-GCP and Declaration of Helsinki principles; no extraction or interviews start before approval, and agency notes are used only under a signed data-sharing agreement.
limitations: Hospital-only complication counts if the agency declines; one service; interview findings explain variation rather than estimate frequency.
summary: Record strand under a consent waiver request, consented interviews, equity sampling and two gates still unknown.
